name: Threads
tagline: Meta's text-first public conversation app, built on Instagram's graph
facts: Global ad rollout to all markets, 2026
Not disclosed; analyst est. low single-digit $B

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Be the open, friendly public square for real-time conversation and ideas.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Replace X as the default text network for news, creators and communities, without the toxicity.

strategy.label: Cold start
strategy.text: Bootstrapped from Instagram's graph: one-tap signup, imported follows; 100M signups in 5 days.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: LLM-powered recommendations drive time spent; add DMs, communities, web and fediverse to deepen habit.

strategy.label: Monetisation
strategy.text: Ads only after scale: tested 2025, global rollout 2026 using Meta's existing advertiser base and Advantage+.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Is Threads a true X replacement, or just Instagram's text tab with weak retention?

customers.who: Existing IG users curious about text
customers.pain: Want conversation without X's toxicity or paywalls
customers.why: One-tap signup, same identity and follows, friendlier tone

customers.pain: Lost reach and trust on X after 2022
customers.why: Large audience, recommendations surface new voices, cross-post from Instagram

customers.pain: Hard to find topic conversations in a for-you feed
customers.why: Topic tags, Meta-curated communities, custom feeds

customers.who: Brands already on Meta Ads Manager
customers.pain: Want brand-safe text inventory and new reach
customers.why: Same Advantage+ campaigns extend to Threads, brand-safe environment

products.name: For You feed
products.desc: Algorithmic feed of posts, LLM-improved ranking

products.name: Topic tags and communities
products.desc: One tag per post; Meta-curated topic communities

products.name: Search and trending
products.desc: Keyword search and trending topics for news

portfolio.north_star: Daily users who post or reply in a meaningful conversation
portfolio.key_metrics: DAU/MAU, replies per post, D30 retention, time spent
portfolio.guardrails: Engagement-bait share, harassment reports, political-content complaints

products.name: Threads DMs
products.desc: 1:1 and group chats up to 50; web since 2026

products.name: Threads web
products.desc: Desktop app with multi-column and messaging

products.name: Fediverse sharing
products.desc: ActivityPub posts to Mastodon and other servers

portfolio.north_star: Weekly users with two-way conversations (replies or DMs)
portfolio.key_metrics: DMs per user, web share of sessions, fediverse follows
portfolio.guardrails: Spam DMs, block rate, account takeovers

products.name: Feed ads
products.desc: Image, carousel and video ads in Threads feed

products.name: Advantage+ placement
products.desc: Threads added as placement in Meta campaigns

products.name: Brand safety controls
products.desc: Third-party verification and inventory filters for advertisers

portfolio.north_star: Ad revenue per DAU without hurting retention
portfolio.key_metrics: Ad load, CPM, CTR, advertiser adoption
portfolio.guardrails: Retention change in ad-exposed cohorts, user sentiment

rows.who_uses: All Threads users in supported markets
rows.who_pays: Brands and SMBs via Meta Ads Manager
rows.how: Auction CPM/CPC; image, carousel, video formats
Meta's AI auto-allocates spend to Threads inventory

rows.who_pays: Indirect: more Meta ad inventory overall
rows.how: Raises Meta-wide time spent and data signals

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: 100% ads, rolled out globally in 2026; not broken out from Meta's $60.4B Q2'26 FoA revenue.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: 500M+ MAU pay nothing; payers are Meta's existing millions of advertisers.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Near-zero marginal infra and sales cost: reuses Instagram identity, Meta ads stack and sales force.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Raise DAU/MAU from ~30%, India and Asia growth, ad load ramp, creator incentives.

friction: Feed full of engagement bait and irrelevant strangers
Weak real-time news versus X during live events
Many signups never return; low DAU/MAU ratio
Political content deprioritised, frustrating news creators
Tied to Instagram identity; separate account deletion historically hard

competitors.label: Text social
competitors.text: X, Bluesky, Mastodon, LinkedIn for professionals

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Instagram graph distribution and Meta ads stack from day one

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Cannibalises Instagram time; may never become the real-time news habit

news.label: Jun 2026
news.text: Threads crosses 500M monthly users, Meta's fastest app to that scale

news.label: May 2026
news.text: DMs launch on web; 350M DMs sent weekly

news.label: Apr 2026
news.text: Full ad inventory opened to global advertisers, 450M+ MAU

news.label: Watch
news.text: DAU/MAU, Threads ad revenue disclosure, X and Bluesky share in news

sources: Meta earnings and newsroom, The Next Web, Storyboard18, analyst estimates and press coverage. Revenue and DAU are estimates. Prepared Oct 2026.
